    • setAsFallbackPublic

      void setAsFallbackPublic()
      "Demote" the user to the lowest public user possible, that preconfigured one. This is intended to be used directly by the authentication check tags, when they need to "invent" an user due to the imposibility of getting it by any mean, but just as a fallback to avoid worse problems (users not accessing anything).
